newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Dec car registrations up 7.5% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Dec car registrations up 7.5% yr/yr.

text.p: Belgian new car registrations rose 7.5 percent in December compared with the same year ago period, the Belgian Automobile Industry Federation (FEBIAC) said on Friday.
Total registrations rose to 17,343 from 16,135 in December 1995.
Volkswagen group maintained its position as leading manufacturer, selling 3,256 cars, although its market share for the month fell to 18.8 percent from 20.8 percent a year ago.
French manufacturers Peugeot-Citroen and Renault were respectively second and third.
